purpose: The frozen, named set of A2 origin-rule variations whose output analysis/a2_block_shift.py is permitted to consume. Replaces the single pinned EXPECTED_VARIATION_SHA256. A variation that is not in this file cannot be analysed, and adding one is a reviewable commit -- there is deliberately no flag, no --force and no --skip-gate. Each variation still requires its OWN regression sentinel recording a PASS for its own sha; membership here is necessary, never sufficient.

permissive_smallest_index.description: Restores one claimant per contested hard index, winner = SMALLEST heavyIndex. The rule named in the pre-registration, chosen to be deterministic and uncorrelated with pT. This is the arm the quoted systematic is measured on.

permissive_largest_index.description: Identical to permissive_smallest_index with the tie-break direction REVERSED: winner = LARGEST heavyIndex. Built by tools/a2_make_largest_index_variation.py, which asserts its source sha; the diff against the pre-registered arm is exactly one comparison operator and its comment. Answers whether the measured multiplicity dependence is a property of restoring one claimant or an artefact of which claimant the pre-registration named.

permissive_smallest_index_guarded.description: The smallest-index rule as first submitted, carrying a per-job throw when a job restored nothing. The throw selected on the outcome variable and discarded 49 of 100 MONASH jobs (ERROR_RECORD E7). Guard-only diff against a4df31e6; the restored totals are identical. Outputs preserved at a2_runs/permissive_guarded_22120383, NOT deleted -- they are the evidence.
permissive_smallest_index_guarded.note: Listed here for provenance only. Entries under `superseded` are NOT admissible: the analyzer looks only at `variations`.
